definition_one_sentence: A customer account with at least one non-cancelled order in the previous 12 months, measured as of the report date.
formula_or_rule: At least one order exists for the account with status != 'cancelled' and order_date within the previous 12 months.
example: An account with a delivered order 10 months ago qualifies; an account whose only order was cancelled does not.
notes_conflicts: Finance standard for board reporting and annual accounts; Sales keeps a separate 6-month view.

definition_one_sentence: Revenue from orders after refunds, excluding VAT and including shipping fees.
formula_or_rule: Per order: (total_amount_eur - refunded_eur) / 1.20, rounded to 2 decimals; shipping is included in total_amount_eur.
example: A €120 order including VAT, with €12 refunded, gives €90 net revenue excluding VAT.
notes_conflicts: Finance definition is canonical. Sales requests a VAT-inclusive measure; keep it as a separate term if needed.

definition_one_sentence: A previously purchasing customer with no non-cancelled order in the previous 12 months, measured as of the report date.
formula_or_rule: At least one order before the 12-month window and no order with status != 'cancelled' during that window.
example: A customer whose latest non-cancelled order was 13 months ago and has had no later non-cancelled order is provisionally churned.
notes_conflicts: No churn window is specified in the materials; provisional 12-month rule aligns with Finance's active-customer definition and requires business-owner validation.

definition_one_sentence: A customer is one ShopFast customer account identified by customer_id; one person may have multiple accounts.
formula_or_rule: Count accounts by distinct customer_id; do not assume one account equals one person.
example: A person with two different customer_id values represents two customer accounts.
notes_conflicts: Based on the account-level definition in stg_customers; confirm approval with the owner.

definition_one_sentence: A ShopFast order is a recorded purchase transaction identified by a unique order_id, including orders that are later cancelled or returned.
formula_or_rule: Each order_id identifies one order; keep the order record even if its status becomes cancelled or returned.
example: An order later cancelled remains an order record with status cancelled.
notes_conflicts: Based on the one-row-per-order definition in stg_orders; confirm approval with the owner.

definition_one_sentence: A customer account with at least one purchase in the previous 6 months, measured as of the report date.
formula_or_rule: At least one order for the account with status != 'cancelled' and order_date within the previous 6 months.
example: An account with a non-cancelled purchase 5 months ago qualifies; one whose last purchase was 7 months ago does not.
notes_conflicts: Sales' six-month view; keep distinct from Finance's 12-month active customer definition.
